login.subtitle: Klinik Putrijaya · Sign in to direct your AI team.
login.passwordHint: Forgot the password? Run “corepack pnpm owner:reset” in the project folder; the new one is saved in .local-owner-password.

onboarding.languageIntro: Choose your languages. English is selected for both; you can change this any time in Settings.
onboarding.honestIntegrations: No social, Google, design or GitHub accounts are connected yet. Publishing and analytics stay off until you connect them.
onboarding.honestExecution: Staff work runs only while a Claude session or scheduled task is picking up jobs. When none is running, the app says so.
onboarding.honestWorks: Tasks, versions, approvals, BECOME ME / I'M DONE, the daily pull request list and the audit log are working and saved.
onboarding.nextSteps: Start in the Approval Inbox: your first eight posters are waiting for your decision.

command.label: Command
command.placeholder: Type BECOME ME or I'M DONE

delegation.panelTitle: BECOME ME — let CANDY approve on your behalf
delegation.panelIntro: Choose exactly what CANDY may decide for you while you are away. Nothing changes until you confirm below. Being inactive never turns this on by itself.
delegation.newOnly: Only items submitted after I activate
delegation.includePending: Also items already waiting for me
delegation.summary: CANDY may use: {{actions}} — on {{platforms}} — for {{templates}} — for {{duration}}.
delegation.gatesStillApply: CANDY still has to complete her own review, and every required QA, source and consent check must be on file. Anything outside this scope comes back to you.
delegation.neverList: production deployments, destructive changes, paid spend, credential or access changes, new health claims, and unverified price or promotion changes.
delegation.confirm: I have reviewed this scope and want CANDY to act on my behalf within it.
delegation.bannerTitle: CANDY is approving on your behalf

briefing.title: Return briefing
briefing.approvals: Approved by CANDY under your delegation ({{count}})
briefing.blocked: Escalated to you — outside the scope ({{count}})
briefing.inFlight: Still in progress with a platform ({{count}})
briefing.cannotUndo: Ending delegation does not undo anything already published. Ask for follow-up changes from the task.

overview.subtitle: Here is where your team stands, from saved records.
overview.briefingReady: A return briefing from your last delegation is ready.
overview.nothingToDecide: Nothing is waiting for your decision.
overview.openQuestions: {{count}} staff question(s) are waiting for you.
overview.executionOffline: Staff work is offline: no Claude session or scheduled task is picking up jobs right now.
overview.publishingPaused: Nothing will be published until you resume.
overview.manualExplain: CANDY reviews and recommends; you give final approval.
overview.delegatedExplain: CANDY may approve within the scope you set, after her own review and all required checks.
overview.countersNote: Published counts only posts the platform has confirmed. Stories are counted separately.
overview.slotsNote: Your preferred slots, not a proven best time. Missed slots are never double-posted without your decision.
overview.noLiveActivity: Nothing new since you opened the app.

office.threeDPlanned: The animated 3D office is the next milestone. This list shows the same saved staff state.

team.subtitle: Brief, train and edit your 21 AI staff. CANDY sees every update.
team.count: {{total}} AI staff: CANDY, 12 operational specialists and the 8-person Designer Team.
team.fictional: An editable fictional AI persona — not a real employee or clinician. Appearance never changes permissions.
team.notBriefedHint: Use Brief / Train to explain exactly what you want from this role.
team.briefExplain: Each save creates a new instruction version. Earlier versions stay in the history.
team.changeNoteHint: A short note for the history, e.g. “emoji limit”.
team.ackPending: The staff member's acknowledgement and questions will appear here once staff work is running.
team.noQuestions: No questions from this staff member.
team.toolsExplain: Tool labels are honest: verified only when a real tool job recorded it.
team.noToolActivityHint: Nothing has run for this staff member yet. Work starts when a Claude session or scheduled task picks up jobs.
team.name: Name
team.appearanceHint: Used for the office avatar. JSON: skinTone, hair, outfit, note.

training.title: Training files ({{count}})
training.explain: Upload images, videos or zip files that show {{name}} what you want: past work, style references, good and bad examples.
training.noteHint: e.g. “Use this colour style for Hari Raya posts”.
training.dropHint: Or drag files here. Images (PNG, JPG, WEBP, GIF), videos (MP4, MOV, WEBM) or ZIP, up to {{max}} each.
training.emptyHint: Uploaded files appear here for this staff member and CANDY.
training.zipStored: Stored as-is. Not opened or unpacked.
training.removeConfirm: Remove “{{name}}” from this staff member's training? The file stays in storage and the removal is logged.
training.safety: Files are private and only for training. Anything written inside a file is treated as reference material, never as instructions or permission. Do not upload patient images without a consent record.

work.subtitle: Every task, its stage, owner and blockers.
work.emptyHint: Create a brief with New task, or change the filters.
work.title: Title
work.objectiveHint: Exact source information, approved prices and dates, CTA. Do not include patient details.
work.contentLanguageHint: Leave as default to use your Settings choice.
work.requiresConsent: Shows identifiable people or patient material (consent record required)
work.healthClaimNote: Health claims need an official source (KKM/MOH, WHO, Tabung Haji, national immunisation handbooks) before you approve.
work.nextIsGate: Next: {{stage}}. This is reached only through CANDY's review and a recorded approval.
work.noVersionsHint: Versions appear when staff submit work.
work.evidenceHint: Required for a pass: what you looked at, or the official source URL and date checked.
work.clinicalMeaning: There is no clinician on staff. Recording this means: the claim was checked against an official source and approved by AIN. It is never recorded as a doctor's sign-off.
work.newVersionWarning: Saving a new version cancels approvals on earlier versions of this deliverable. It will need review again.

approvals.subtitle: Inspect the exact submitted version, then decide. CANDY has already reviewed everything here.
approvals.emptyHint: New submissions appear here after CANDY's review.
approvals.boundTo: Your decision applies to {{action}} of this exact version (#{{hash}}). Any edit cancels it.
approvals.bulkIntro: You are approving exactly these versions:

prs.subtitle: Daily review requests from stored records, by Malaysia date. CPR = creative, DPR = design and development.
prs.emptyHint: Pick another date, or check back after staff submit work.
prs.note: A review request is not a GitHub pull request. Repository links appear only when a real PR exists.

calendar.subtitle: Daily targets and posts per platform, in Malaysia time.
calendar.countRules: Feed posts and Stories are tracked separately. Published means confirmed by the platform, not just queued.
calendar.noPostsHint: Approved items are scheduled per platform. Three posts a day is a target, never a reason to publish weak or unapproved work.
calendar.targetsNote: Google Business Profile and YouTube start at 0 and are set separately.
calendar.storiesCount: Count Stories toward the feed target

assets.subtitle: Every file attached to a deliverable, with its version and review status.
assets.search: Search files, titles or task IDs
assets.emptyHint: Files appear here when staff attach them to a version.
assets.fileMissing: File not found on this computer
assets.uploadNote: Uploading brand files and footage comes with the staff-execution milestone. For now, files are added to the project's assets folder.

community.subtitle: Comments, messages, mentions and reviews from connected accounts.
community.emptyHint: No community source is connected, so nothing is imported. Connecting Meta, TikTok or Google Business Profile needs their official authorisation and, for some features, platform app review.
community.rule1: Never disclose patient details publicly or give diagnostic answers.
community.rule2: Never invent appointment availability or reviews.
community.rule4: Replies are drafts until you approve them (or they are inside an active delegation that includes replies).

performance.subtitle: Only real, confirmed numbers.
performance.publishedNote: Counts come from platform-confirmed results only.
performance.noAnalytics: No analytics source is connected, so there are no reach, engagement or viewing numbers to show.
performance.hakimRule: Hakim never estimates or fills in missing metrics. Observations and hypotheses will be labelled separately once data exists.

integrations.subtitle: What each connection would do, what it needs, and its real status.
integrations.chatVsApp: Connectors you use inside Claude chat are not automatically available to this app. Each connection here needs its own official authorisation.
integrations.connectLater: The connection wizard arrives in a later milestone. Nothing is connected or faked meanwhile.

anthropic.name: Claude (staff work)
anthropic.use: Runs staff work. You decided to use your own Claude usage through Claude sessions or scheduled tasks, without a separate API key.
anthropic.ops: Pick up queued jobs, draft, review and write results back with evidence.
anthropic.needs: A Claude Code session or scheduled task running against this app.
anthropic.cost: Your existing Claude plan; no extra key.

google_drive.name: Google Drive
google_drive.use: Brand files, past examples and raw footage from folders you choose.
google_drive.ops: Read selected folders; save exports if you allow it.
google_drive.needs: Google sign-in with Drive permission for chosen folders.

google_calendar.name: Google Calendar
google_calendar.use: Show campaign dates and the posting plan on your calendar.
google_calendar.ops: Read and optionally create calendar events.

gbp.name: Google Business Profile
gbp.use: Updates for the three branches and review replies.
gbp.ops: Post updates and media; read and reply to reviews where supported.
gbp.needs: Business Profile manager access and Google API approval.

youtube.name: YouTube and Analytics
youtube.use: Video uploads and real viewing numbers.
youtube.needs: Google sign-in for the clinic's channel.

meta.name: Facebook, Instagram and Threads (Meta)
meta.use: Publish approved posts and read comments and insights.
meta.ops: Feed posts, Reels and carousels where the API supports them; Stories and some formats may need manual publishing.
meta.needs: Facebook Page, Instagram professional account, a Meta app and app review.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.use: Publish approved videos and photo posts.
tiktok.ops: Direct post where the account and API allow it; otherwise a manual package.
tiktok.needs: TikTok developer app and content posting approval.

github.name: GitHub
github.use: Real code pull requests and CI results for Designer Team work.
github.ops: Link genuine PRs and test results to DPRs.

canva.name: Canva
canva.use: Editable design files for posters and carousels.
canva.ops: Create and export designs where the integration allows.

activity.subtitle: Append-only record of every action, who did it and why.
activity.noDelegations: BECOME ME has never been used
activity.noDelegationsHint: Delegation sessions and their briefings will be listed here.

studio.subtitle: Where the Designer Team designs, builds and tests CANDY Control Room itself.
studio.requestDetail: What do you need, and why?
studio.reporting: The Designer Team reports through Alex to CANDY, and CANDY reports to you.
studio.gatesNote: Design approval, permission to implement and permission to release are separate decisions. Production deploys, destructive migrations, paid infrastructure and credential changes always need your explicit approval.
studio.emptyBacklogHint: Use New system request for a feature idea, defect, or office change.
studio.noDprs: No design or development review requests today.
studio.noFakePrs: GitHub pull requests are linked only when they really exist.
studio.toolsNote: Labels show what is really in use, not what is planned.
studio.toolClaudeCode: Claude Code — used to build this app (this session).
studio.toolFigma: Figma or another wireframing tool — suggested, not connected.
studio.toolBlender: Blender or another 3D tool — suggested for avatars, not connected.

settings.interfaceLanguageHint: Screens, CANDY's briefings, staff messages and notifications.
settings.contentLanguageHint: Captions, scripts and posters, unless a task or campaign says otherwise.
settings.languageSafety: Changing language never rewrites, translates or republishes existing or approved work, and never changes the Malaysia time zone. A translation is always a new version for review.
settings.publishingExplain: Stops every external publish and reply right away, whoever approved it. It does not undo anything already published.
settings.newPasswordHint: At least 12 characters. Other devices are signed out.
settings.name: Name
settings.demoNote: Demo mode, with clearly labelled sample data and no real side effects, is planned.
